phases.title: Opening a site
phases.sub: Once per site, in this order.

phases.title: Running it
phases.sub: Every day the site is live.

stages.title: Sourcing
stages.why: Find the sites worth opening and get in the room. Every site is chosen for the task categories it adds, not just the hours.
do: Keep a live target list: facility types and geography ranked against the categories we need more of, with the upload path in mind
Reach out through the personal network and direct approaches
Employee referral program: 10% reward on a closed site contract
Portfolio Managers source for their own books and earn the same reward
stages.done: A meeting booked with a decision maker at a site that fits the category plan.

stages.title: Closing and legal
stages.owner: Adham and Youssif, with Mano on paperwork
stages.why: Make the site ours on paper before anyone shows up with a phone.
do: Meet the owner, walk the site, agree what we film and what we pay
Sign the participation agreement; confirm signage and consent requirements
Set access hours, entry permissions, and the site's safety rules
stages.done: Signed agreement, access confirmed, payment terms recorded with Mano.

stages.title: Pre-launch alignment
stages.owner: Mazen, Moharam, and the site's Portfolio Manager
stages.why: Design the operation for this specific floor before Day 0.
do: Full walk-through: recording zones, sensitive areas that are off limits, power outlets, where equipment lives
Confirm the upload path: line, router, or depot run
Agree the site's safety protocol and PPE
stages.done: A site plan with zones, power, storage, upload path, and shift pattern.

stages.title: Central planning and provisioning
stages.why: Match the site plan to hardware and a number.
do: Set phone count, mounts, caps, chargers, and spares
Set the daily hour quota and the start date
Order gear, book transport, provision accounts through onboarding screening
stages.done: Hardware allocated and labeled, accounts created, quota on the dashboard.

stages.title: Day 0
stages.why: Everything works before the first real hour.
do: Set up charging stations and the device room
Label every phone and mount; verify the network from the floor
Sign forms: ID copy, consent, fraud briefing sign-off, one account per person
Orient wearers: angle, the 30-minute cycle, hat off means tap stop
Run live pilot recordings and check them for angle and lighting
stages.done: Pilot footage reviewed, every wearer papered, Moharam certifies the launch.

stages.title: Filming
do: Rotations set so no wearer sits on one task all week
30-minute cycles run and restarted on time
Charging, custody, clock-in and clock-out enforced
Nothing sleeps holding more than a day of footage
stages.done: Hours land on target with clean footage, every day.

stages.title: Quality review
stages.owner: Youssef Medhat and the Portfolio Manager
stages.why: Nothing bad leaves, and repeat offenders are caught early.
do: Every uploaded video reviewed: keep, flag, or delete
Flags to the Portfolio Manager same day, to the worker within 24 hours
Three flags pulls the worker; two strikes pauses the device
Month-end audit passes before invoicing
stages.done: Flag rate falling week over week; no surprises from the client.

stages.title: Daily reporting
stages.why: One truthful number for the company every night.
do: Each Portfolio Manager sends the wrap report: hours, active phones, hardware, problems, fixes
Mano consolidates into the company view and the founders' evening number
stages.done: The number is on the dashboard before the executive sync.

stages.title: Executive sync
do: Review every site against quota
Move phones and people where the hours are
Clear escalations that came up during the day
Feed the weekly client update Adham sends
stages.done: Tomorrow's plan is set and everyone with a problem has an answer.

loops.text: The site plan sets the hardware plan, the hardware plan reshapes the site plan, until both agree.
Filming feeds review, review corrects filming, every day.

back.text: Then back to stage 6. Filming, review, reporting, and the sync repeat every day for as long as the site runs.
